predicate.label: contributed writing to publication
predicate.definition: Person X wrote, reviewed or contributed as a critic for publication Y.
includes: wrote/reviewed for or in a publication
explicit critic for publication with authorship role
excludes: merely quoted or mentioned in publication
ordinary communication or employment without authorship
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: wrote/reviewed for or in a publication; explicit critic for publication with authorship role. Excludes: merely quoted or mentioned in publication; publication location; ordinary communication or employment without authorship. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: say-in without author/quoted-speaker distinction.

rationale: Write-in6 plus explicit writing/reviewing and reviewer-for paths dominate authorship for publications; say-in9 is ambiguous quotation versus authorship and must not automatically pass.
